intent: Increase vegetation/natural complexity through maintained tree pits and cause-based low understory while preserving the benchmark's ordinary midsummer Japanese residential-estate character.

assemblies.establishment: Existing plaza paving is locally interrupted around planted trees; exposed root-zone soil is retained by small modular precast concrete edging rather than allowing the trunk to emerge directly through an undifferentiated paving slab.
assemblies.nominalDimensions: soil opening diameter 1.48-1.72 m depending on anchor; soil visual thickness 24 mm mostly embedded; 12 edging modules; edging section 150 x 80 mm with tangential length derived from pit circumference
assemblies.materialsFinish: dry mineral topsoil with compacted fine aggregate; matte non-metallic precast concrete edging with small physical chamfers
assemblies.mounting: soil disk is visually recessed into the paving top and edging modules follow the perimeter tangentially; generated art is collider-free and leaves the existing ground collision unchanged
assemblies.interfaces: trunk/root flare -> soil opening -> precast edging -> plaza paving; no unexplained dark painted ring is allowed
assemblies.orientationExposure: upward-facing, rain/sun exposed, high pedestrian-pressure edge on the circulation side
assemblies.aging: ordinary compaction, mild soil darkening near the trunk and slight concrete edge wear are permitted; damage/disaster cues are prohibited
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: pit depth/edge silhouette and module gaps are geometry; soil grain and concrete microtexture remain material detail
assemblies.lodPolicy: tree-pit substrate and edging remain simple static geometry; added biological understory uses explicit LOD0/1/2/3
assemblies.lookdevBrief: At frontal view the pit must read as a maintained planting opening, not a brown decal. At grazing view the 80 mm edging height and physical chamfers should catch a narrow real highlight/shadow. At 100 percent crop the trunk must not appear to grow directly through paving.

assemblies.establishment: Sparse spontaneous/maintained low vegetation establishes within the root zone. Density is reduced toward the nearest pedestrian-pressure source and remains denser on protected sides instead of being distributed uniformly.
assemblies.nominalDimensions: plant height 0.18-0.42 m; leaf-rosette spread approximately 0.20-0.36 m at LOD0; paved pits use 7-9 source plants while grass-ground trees use 16-22 source plants before LOD reduction
assemblies.materialsFinish: thin dielectric foliage using the existing two-sided foliage transmission model; small green stems reuse non-metallic foliage material
assemblies.mounting: plants originate from the root-zone ground surface; no floating plants and no plants attached to concrete or metal
assemblies.interfaces: root-zone soil/grass -> stem -> leaf spray; circulation-facing sector has lower occupancy due to ordinary foot traffic/maintenance pressure
assemblies.orientationExposure: midsummer sun/sky context from the existing deterministic environment; individual rosettes have deterministic yaw and modest pitch variation
assemblies.aging: ordinary summer growth with modest size/color variation only; no dead-tree, storm, disaster or reconstruction narrative
assemblies.geometryVsMaterial: stem direction, rosette silhouette, spacing and LOD reduction are explicit geometry; leaf vein/color and transmitted-light response are material/shader detail
assemblies.lodPolicy: four renderer-distinct levels with animated cross-fade; plant population is progressively reduced and stems are removed after LOD1; visible LOD pop is an automatic fail
assemblies.lookdevBrief: Close view should reveal several independent low plants and small stems without a stamped circular pattern. Oblique view should show a lower-density pedestrian-facing sector. Far view should collapse smoothly without shimmer or a sudden green ring.

materials.albedoGuidance: dry warm-brown mineral soil; no baked lighting or black contact-shadow halo
materials.normalScaleGuidance: fine soil/aggregate microrelief only; pit depth remains geometric
materials.microstructure: fine mineral grains, small aggregate and compaction variation
materials.wetnessResponse: not active in the dry benchmark; if a wet variant is later authored, albedo may darken and roughness may fall locally where water plausibly accumulates
materials.uvAging: no UV hue shift beyond mild ordinary summer desaturation
materials.angularFresnelResponse: weak dielectric grazing reflection; never metallic

materials.albedoGuidance: neutral aged precast concrete without painted edge highlights
materials.normalScaleGuidance: small aggregate and pores; 80 mm section and chamfer are geometry
materials.microstructure: washed/aged cement paste with visible fine aggregate
materials.wetnessResponse: dry benchmark only; any future wet state must be source/catchment based
materials.uvAging: small exposure-driven lightening permitted, no stylized bleaching

materials.albedoGuidance: midsummer green foliage with cluster-level variation; no emissive green
materials.normalScaleGuidance: leaf micro-normal/vein response from the existing foliage material
materials.microstructure: thin leaf lamina with vein-scale normal variation
materials.wetnessResponse: dry benchmark; no generic wet sheen
materials.angularFresnelResponse: two-sided dielectric leaf response with modest transmission under coherent midsummer sun

automaticFail: tree trunk visibly emerging through uninterrupted plaza paving with no planting interface
uniform circular/stamped understory distribution immediately obvious at benchmark framing
floating vegetation or vegetation rooted in concrete/metal
visible Unity primitive mesh in ecology detail
claiming vegetation visual quality without an actual Unity render

verification: Source/contract only. Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile and native 3840x2160 render evidence are still required before any Visual Fidelity points are awarded.
